svg.title: The core's state, and what lies outside it
svg.desc: Two columns on black. Left, inside the struct wof_state_t and saved: the magic and the version a load checks; the seed and the entropy stream's state; the counts of VBlanks, ticks and calls of the pass entry; the video rate and the joystick's last state; the flip's preference and whether it was given; the stand-ins reached and the VBlanks since a pass; the keyboard assist's presses and pushes; Paula's channels and their interrupts (paula); the music's timer and the level-4 vector (cia); the registered variables of src/globals.def (g); the registered tables of src/mission.def with the records of src/records.def (m); the front end: the coroutines' resume points and the locals they keep, the viewports, the display memory and the mirror markers (f). Right, outside the state and not saved: the arena with the packed files, never changed once loaded, and the assets loaded from them, changed only as the state's mirror markers say; the framebuffer and its palettes, made again from the state at every call of the pass entry and at every load; the queue of mixed audio frames; the overlay of written files, which loading a state must not un-write; the settings wof_init leaves alone, the fade step, the VBlanks a pass and the audio output rate; the native library's recording and the tests' entries, never compiled into the page.
svg.text: The core's state, and what lies outside it
wof_state_t is copied whole into a save state and zeroed by wof_init; nothing outside it is saved
